{{short description|Russian mathematician}}
{{use dmy dates|date=April 2021}}
'''Vladimir Iosifovich Kondrashov''' ({{lang|ru|Владимир Иосифович Кондрашов}}; 2 February 1909 – 26 February 1971) was a Soviet mathematician most well known for proving the [[Rellich–Kondrachov theorem]] that shows that the embedding of certain [[Sobolev space]]s into [[Lp space|L<sup>''p''</sup> spaces]] is [[Compact embedding|compact]]. His name has also been transliterated as V.I. Kondrachoff, W. Kondrachov, or V.I. Kondrašov.<ref name="ams">{{Cite web |url=https://mathscinet.ams.org/mathscinet/MRAuthorID/478194 |title=MR: Kondrashov, Vladimir Iosifovich - 478194 |website=mathscinet.ams.org |access-date=2019-07-26 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190724211029/https://mathscinet.ams.org/mathscinet/MRAuthorID/478194 |archive-date=2019-07-24 |url-status=live }}</ref>

== Life ==
Kondrashov was born on {{OldStyleDate|2 February|1909|20 January}} in Moscow.<ref name=obit>{{Cite journal |last1=Kudryavtsev |first1=L D |author-link1=Lev Kudryavtsev|last2=Lizorkin |first2=P I |author-link2=Petr Ivanovich Lizorkin|last3=Nikol'skii |first3=Sergei M |author-link3=Sergey Nikolsky|last4=Sobolev |first4=S L |author-link4=Sergey Sobolev|date=1972-04-30 |title=VLADIMIR IOSIFOVICH KONDRASHOV (obituary) |journal=Russian Mathematical Surveys |volume=27 |issue=2 |pages=83–90 |doi=10.1070/rm1972v027n02abeh001372 |issn=0036-0279|bibcode=1972RuMaS..27...83K |s2cid=250813276 }}</ref> He graduated with a PhD from [[Moscow State University]] under the supervision of [[Sergei Sobolev]] in 1941. As a postdoc at [[Steklov Institute]], where he obtained a DSc in 1950, he organised the Moscow Seminar on the Theory of Functions of Several Variables.<ref name="matmat">{{Cite book |title=History of Banach Spaces and Linear Operators |date=2007 |publisher=Birkhäuser Boston |isbn=9780817645960 |editor-last=Pietsch |editor-first=Albrecht |location=Boston, MA |pages=606 |language=en |doi=10.1007/978-0-8176-4596-0_8}}</ref><ref name="ras">{{Cite web |url=http://www.mi-ras.ru/index.php?c=show_dep&id=5&showmode=groups&filter=1&l=1#seminars |title=Steklov Mathematical Institute |website=www.mi-ras.ru |access-date=2019-07-26}}</ref>
For the final 20 years of his life until his death on 26 February 1971, he worked at the [[Moscow Engineering and Physics Institute]].<ref name=obit />
